name: Advanced Filesystem: PDF Processor
description: PDF processing submodule of Advanced FileSystem: pdftotext/pdfinfo text and metadata extraction, Ghostscript thumbnails and PDF/A export, page split/merge/keep/remove/rotate/resize, watermark, compress, password add/remove, Tesseract OCR, image extraction and a diff viewer, with PII detection and a per-file dashboard.

suggests.poppler-utils (pdftotext, pdfinfo, pdfim: external binaries — text extraction, metadata, embedded-image extraction.
suggests.ghostscript (gs): external binary — thumbnails, PDF/A, split/merge/keep/rotate/resize, watermark, compress, password.
suggests.tesseract-ocr: external binary — OCR of scanned/rasterised PDFs via ocrFile().
suggests.imagemagick (convert): external binary — reported in system status.

project_description: Advanced Filesystem: PDF Processor adds a PDF-centric processing pipeline to the Advanced FileSystem framework. Its core pipeline extracts plain text with pdftotext, reads metadata and page count with pdfinfo, renders a first-page thumbnail with Ghostscript, detects whether a PDF is scanned (little extractable text) or PDF/A, and can auto-export to PDF/A. A rich set of derivative operations (all shelling out to Ghostscript, Tesseract or poppler and tracked in adfs_pdf_derivatives) covers page-range extraction, keep/remove pages, split into equal chunks, merge multiple PDFs, rotate/resize pages, text watermark, compression presets, add/remove open password, per-page thumbnails, Tesseract OCR of rasterised pages, embedded-image extraction (pdfimages) and PDF/A conversion. A regex PII detector flags CPF/CNPJ/e-mail/phone/card patterns. Files are processed on upload (queue), in batch, or per file, with a dashboard of coverage/scan/PII stats, a diff viewer that rasterises and compares two PDFs page-by-page, and an autocomplete endpoint. Every route and private-derivative download is gated behind the restricted 'administer advanced_filesystem_pdf_processor' permission.
